step1.ptxt: Precautions for Handling and Servicing SRS Airbag System

atten3.ptxt: This service procedure includes work that affects the SRS airbag; always check the SRS airbag precautions before starting work.

step1.ptxt: Precautions for Removal, Installation and Replacement of Electric Power Steering Components

step2.ptxt: When removing or installing the steering gear assembly, always set the front wheels in the straight-ahead position.
When disconnecting the sliding yoke of the steering column from the pinion shaft of the steering gear, always place matchmarks on the sliding yoke and pinion shaft before starting work.
